stem.en: A gene's promoter is deleted by a mutation. The gene's own letters are perfect. Kabir says "so the protein will still be made, just a bit late". What happens?

text.en: The protein is never made. The copyist cannot land, so no mRNA is written, so the workshop never sees the recipe. A perfect recipe with no start sign is a page nobody opens.

feedback.en: The copyist does not search. It grips promoters. No promoter, no grip, ever.

text.en: It is made from the other strand instead.

feedback.en: The other strand is not a spare recipe; it is the complement. Read backwards it spells nonsense, and it has no promoter either.

text.en: It is made twice as much, because there is no sign to stop.

feedback.en: The sign is a start, not a stop. Removing it removes the start.

explanation.en: The promoter is the door. A gene behind a bricked-up door is intact and silent. Book VI.6 uses this: switch a gene off by blocking its door.
